quests.instruction: What sound do drops of water make when they fall?
quests.hint: What sound do drops of water make when they fall?
quests.explanation: Great job! On a rainy day, water drops fall from the clouds.
quests.funFact: Raindrops start as tiny drops of water inside a cloud.
quests.wordExample: I hear the rain falling outside.

quests.instruction: What do you see shining high up in the sky?
quests.hint: What do you see shining high up in the sky?
quests.explanation: Great job! On a sunny day, the sky is bright and blue.
quests.funFact: Sunlight takes about eight minutes to travel from the sun to Earth.
quests.wordExample: The sun is bright and sunny today.

quests.instruction: Look up at the soft, puffy shapes above you.
quests.hint: Look up at the soft, puffy shapes above you.
quests.explanation: You got it! Clouds can look like soft cotton balls in the sky.
quests.funFact: Some clouds are shaped like waves, and some look like feathers.
quests.wordExample: It looks cloudy outside this morning.

quests.instruction: Think about the small pools of water you can jump in.
quests.hint: Think about the small pools of water you can jump in.
quests.explanation: Yes! Puddles form on the ground when it is rainy.
quests.funFact: A puddle is just a small pool of water on the ground.
quests.wordExample: I jump over puddles when it is rainy.

quests.instruction: This weather can make you want to wear sunglasses.
quests.hint: This weather can make you want to wear sunglasses.
quests.explanation: Yes! Sunny weather feels warm and bright on your skin.
quests.funFact: The sun is really a giant, glowing star in the sky.
quests.wordExample: It feels warm and sunny outside.

quests.instruction: Think of the cold weather that paints the whole world white.
quests.hint: Think of the cold weather that paints the whole world white.
quests.explanation: Great choice! On this kind of day, the ground turns soft and white.
quests.funFact: Snowflakes almost always have six sides, no matter their shape.
quests.wordExample: I wear my mittens because it is snowy.

quests.instruction: Where do you think the sun went? Look at what is covering it.
quests.hint: Where do you think the sun went? Look at what is covering it.
quests.explanation: Yes! On this kind of day, clouds cover the sun in the sky.
quests.funFact: Clouds form when tiny drops of water gather together in the sky.
quests.wordExample: The sky is cloudy and grey.

quests.instruction: Think of the tool you hold over your head to stay dry.
quests.hint: Think of the tool you hold over your head to stay dry.
quests.explanation: That's right! An umbrella keeps you dry when it is rainy.
quests.funFact: Rain happens when clouds get too heavy to hold all of their water.
quests.wordExample: I hold my umbrella when it is rainy.

quests.instruction: Look down by your feet. Do you see a dark shape?
quests.hint: Look down by your feet. Do you see a dark shape?
quests.explanation: That's right! Bright sunshine makes clear, dark shadows.
quests.funFact: Your shadow moves and changes shape as the sun moves.
quests.wordExample: My shadow is long on a sunny afternoon.

quests.instruction: Think about the fun, cold activity you can build with your hands.
quests.hint: Think about the fun, cold activity you can build with your hands.
quests.explanation: You got it! You can build a snowman on a day like this.
quests.funFact: Every single snowflake has its own unique shape.
quests.wordExample: We build a snowman on a snowy day.

quests.instruction: What do you feel pushing softly against your cheeks outside?
quests.hint: What do you feel pushing softly against your cheeks outside?
quests.explanation: Great choice! Strong moving air pushing on your face means it is windy.
quests.funFact: Wind is simply air that is moving from one place to another.
quests.wordExample: Hold your hat, it is windy!

quests.instruction: Count the fluffy white shapes floating above your head.
quests.hint: Count the fluffy white shapes floating above your head.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Big, fluffy, white shapes covering the sky mean it is cloudy.
quests.funFact: No two clouds ever look exactly the same.
quests.wordExample: Big fluffy shapes filled the cloudy sky.

quests.instruction: Look at the color of the sky, then look for falling drops.
quests.hint: Look at the color of the sky, then look for falling drops.
quests.explanation: Correct! Grey skies with falling drops of water mean it is rainy.
quests.funFact: Raindrops are shaped more like tiny hamburger buns than teardrops.
quests.wordExample: The grey sky turned rainy in the afternoon.

quests.instruction: Look up and count the clouds. How many do you see?
quests.hint: Look up and count the clouds. How many do you see?
quests.explanation: Correct! A clear sky with no clouds is a sunny sky.
quests.funFact: A clear sky often means calm, gentle weather is on the way.
quests.wordExample: The sky was clear and sunny all morning.

quests.instruction: Think of the cold weather that lets you slide down a hill fast.
quests.hint: Think of the cold weather that lets you slide down a hill fast.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Snowy hills are perfect for sledding.
quests.funFact: Some places get so much snow that people dig tunnels to walk through.
quests.wordExample: We went sledding because it was snowy.

quests.instruction: Watch the tall trees. What are their branches doing?
quests.hint: Watch the tall trees. What are their branches doing?
quests.explanation: Yes! Swaying, shaking branches are a clear sign it is windy.
quests.funFact: You cannot see wind, but you can watch it move the leaves and trees.
quests.wordExample: The trees swayed on a windy day.

quests.instruction: What color is the sky when the sun cannot shine through?
quests.hint: What color is the sky when the sun cannot shine through?
quests.explanation: That's right! A soft grey sky instead of blue means it is cloudy.
quests.funFact: Clouds look grey when they are thick and full of water.
quests.wordExample: The grey sky looked cloudy all day.

quests.instruction: Think about the weather that gardens need to grow.
quests.hint: Think about the weather that gardens need to grow.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Rain gives water to flowers, trees, and grass.
quests.funFact: Rain fills up the rivers and lakes that we get our water from.
quests.wordExample: The garden grew well after a rainy week.

quests.instruction: Think about what you wear to protect your eyes outside.
quests.hint: Think about what you wear to protect your eyes outside.
quests.explanation: Great choice! We wear sunglasses to protect our eyes on days like this.
quests.funFact: Sunglasses were first made to help people see better in bright light.
quests.wordExample: I wear a hat because it is sunny.

quests.instruction: Picture the ground covered by something soft and white, like a blanket.
quests.hint: Picture the ground covered by something soft and white, like a blanket.
quests.explanation: That's right! A soft white blanket on the ground means it is snowy.
quests.funFact: Freshly fallen snow can make the whole world feel extra quiet.
quests.wordExample: A white blanket covered the snowy ground.

quests.instruction: Think of the weather that helps kites lift up and soar.
quests.hint: Think of the weather that helps kites lift up and soar.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Windy weather helps kites lift up and fly high.
quests.funFact: Kites need moving air underneath them to stay up in the sky.
quests.wordExample: We fly a kite on a windy day.

quests.instruction: Something fluffy is floating in front of the sun. What is it?
quests.hint: Something fluffy is floating in front of the sun. What is it?
quests.explanation: Correct! Clouds can block the sun from view.
quests.funFact: Even on a cloudy day, some sunlight still reaches the ground.
quests.wordExample: Clouds blocked the sun on a cloudy day.

quests.instruction: Think about the special boots made for wet, splashy days.
quests.hint: Think about the special boots made for wet, splashy days.
quests.explanation: Yes! Rain boots keep your feet dry on rainy days.
quests.funFact: Frogs and toads often become much more active during rainy weather.
quests.wordExample: I wear my rain boots when it is rainy.

quests.instruction: What color does the sky turn when it is full of light?
quests.hint: What color does the sky turn when it is full of light?
quests.explanation: You got it! Bright light makes everything look golden and cheerful.
quests.funFact: Sunlight is actually made of every color mixed together.
quests.wordExample: The park looked golden in the sunny light.

quests.instruction: Look up and watch for small, soft, white shapes falling down.
quests.hint: Look up and watch for small, soft, white shapes falling down.
quests.explanation: Correct! Tiny white flakes falling from the sky mean it is snowy.
quests.funFact: Snow looks white because it reflects almost all the light that hits it.
quests.wordExample: Tiny white flakes fell on a snowy morning.

quests.instruction: Think about what happens to loose hair on a gusty day.
quests.hint: Think about what happens to loose hair on a gusty day.
quests.explanation: That's right! Moving air can blow your hair around on a windy day.
quests.funFact: A strong gust of wind can move much faster than you can run.
quests.wordExample: My hair blew around on a windy afternoon.

quests.instruction: Picture a sky filled with fluffy white and grey shapes.
quests.hint: Picture a sky filled with fluffy white and grey shapes.
quests.explanation: Yes! A sky full of soft, puffy shapes is a cloudy sky.
quests.funFact: Fluffy, puffy clouds are called cumulus clouds.
quests.wordExample: The sky was full of shapes on a cloudy day.

quests.instruction: Look at the window. What do you see sliding down the glass?
quests.hint: Look at the window. What do you see sliding down the glass?
quests.explanation: Correct! Raindrops often slide down windows during rainy weather.
quests.funFact: Raindrops leave streaky trails as they slide down glass.
quests.wordExample: I watched the rain slide down the window.

quests.instruction: Think of the weather that makes you want to play outside all day.
quests.hint: Think of the weather that makes you want to play outside all day.
quests.explanation: Yes! Warm, bright days are perfect for picnics outside.
quests.funFact: Plants use sunlight to make their own food.
quests.wordExample: We had a picnic because it was sunny.

quests.instruction: Think about the warmest clothes you own for the coldest days.
quests.hint: Think about the warmest clothes you own for the coldest days.
quests.explanation: Yes! A coat, mittens, and scarf are perfect for snowy weather.
quests.funFact: Some animals grow extra thick fur to stay warm in snowy weather.
quests.wordExample: I wear mittens and a scarf when it is snowy.
